book.name: Matiu
book.title: Yisasife huno Kanale Kea Matiu Kae-malenea Ke.

content: Anumaya KotiꞋa kahegi kemoꞋa tototimogami kahegi kemona agase-maine.

Ani yupa nagoꞋa Falasia vayaꞋene kahegi kema havilinaya anagaꞋene Yelusalemuti Yisasite eꞋya mage huꞋya hae “NaꞋa higeꞋya kagaiꞋenema tokaeꞋya nemaiya anagaꞋmoꞋya taginagomogami kea ali-tagaeꞋya kaveꞋma negahena amayana sese nohae?*” huꞋya havigae.
Hageno YisasiꞋa kenonaꞋamia mage hie NaꞋa higetama tamakinagomogami auꞋavala akaveꞋma malaya yafe Anumaya Koti kahegi kea ago neꞋatagayae?
Anumaya KotiꞋa agaiꞋa autaꞋmafina mage huno hu-maineane.

content.text: “Tamakaya itatami afotamimogami amakia alisaga nehutama keꞋamia veganokano ohutama amaiyaꞋafinaga maiho. Nago kanomoga itakafokamona kamugema vaitenukahena faligane.” huno hu-maineane.

content: Hu-maineanagi tamakaya mage hutama nehae “Nago kanomoꞋa itaꞋafoꞋamogani anaya hisia monema hanesigenoꞋma itaꞋafoꞋamoganima anaya ohinunoꞋa mage huno hisie ‘Ani monea Anumaya Kotina amisua yane huꞋna hu-mainoe.’ huno hinunoꞋa nefana aya huno agia alisaga ohisie.” hutama nehae. Ani ke nehutama tamakinagomogami auꞋavala akaveꞋma malaya yafe “Anumaya Koti kea afa ya kana nehie.” nehutama alitama neꞋatagayae.
Tamakaya vagala vaya mainae. AisaiyaꞋa Anumaya Koti aune kanomoꞋa tamakaifena tamage huno Anumaya Koti autaꞋmafina mage huno hu-maineane

content.text: “Ani nofi veaꞋmoꞋya amavayaleti nagai nagia alisaga nehagi amakuꞋamoꞋa aluꞋale hanegeꞋya ani kavala nehae.
Ma mopafi veaꞋmoꞋya malenaya kahegi kehena ‘Mamona Anumaya Koti ke hanegi akave maleho.’ huꞋya nehayanagi nagai nagia alisaga nehayanagi afa kava maiꞋya nehae.” huno kae-maleneane.

content: YisasiꞋa veaꞋmogami amakuꞋama ali haviya nehia yafe hu-maine.
YisasiꞋa agaite esae huno kasagoꞋya veaꞋmogamifena ke higeꞋya ageno mage huno hie “Tamakaya mani kea havilama hutama haviho.
Nagola tamavayafima nesaya yamoꞋa tamakuꞋamona alino oniꞋyaꞋagela ohugahigi tamavayafitiꞋma hati-lavisia yamo ali-falote hisigeno tamakuꞋamoꞋa oniyaꞋagela hugahie.” huno hu-maine.
HigeꞋya agaiꞋaenema tokaeꞋya nemaiya anagaꞋmoꞋya Yisasife mage huꞋya hae “Falasia vayaꞋmoꞋya ani kea haviteꞋya amaipa kafa he-gataya kea ago havimainano?” huꞋya hae.
Hageno YisasiꞋa mage huno hama-paiye “Ikapinaga mainea NenafaꞋa okalinesia yana agaiꞋa mevakaino hafuꞋyaene tagasi hugahie.

Tamakaya mani vayafena tamakesa ohaviho. Amaulaga asu hu-mainea vaya mainae. NagoꞋma aulaga asu hu-mainea kanomoꞋa nago aulaga asu hu-mainea afaluꞋamona avaleno vaiyesiana tolemogania komufi asaga hu-lavigaꞋe.” huno hie.
Higeno PitaꞋa Yisasife mage hie “Kagaya mani avame kemo aepaꞋa hugeta havimano.” huno hie.
Higeno YisasiꞋa mage huno hie “Tamakaya meni kanaene havilama ohunetama nehao?
Tamakaya ohavinao? MukiꞋa yama tamavayafi nageno tamakuꞋafina oꞋunogi tamaipafike taviteno haenagaꞋa aifayolagafi tavino afa ya kana nehie.
Afa ya kana nehianagi nago yana tamavayafitiꞋma hati-lavia kemoꞋa tamakupiti falote huno tamakuꞋamona alino oniꞋyaꞋagela nehie.

TamakuꞋafinagati efalote hia yana maꞋa huno falote nehie kanale ohu tagu tagesa nehavuna yaꞋene vaya he-fali kavaꞋene alu kanomo aꞋne avayu hu yaꞋene aꞋne munaꞋnele kumai he yaꞋene musufaya hu yaꞋene havige hu-ma-te yaꞋene kamuge vai-ma-te yaꞋene taguꞋafitila ali falote nehie.
NaꞋama haya yafe tamakupina oniꞋyaꞋagela tamahau-mainegi veaꞋmoꞋya amayama sese ohuꞋya kaveꞋma naya yamoꞋa amakupina oniꞋyaꞋagela ohugahie.” huno hu-maine.
Kenani aꞋmoꞋa Yisasina aguꞋa amitafa hu-maine.
YisasiꞋa nemaiya kumala ataleno Taiya kotegaene Saitoni kotegaene umaine.

Umainegeno nagola anile mainea Kenani aꞋmoꞋa, Yuta vea omainea aꞋmoꞋa, agaife ke huno mage me hie “Ala kanomogae, Tevitina aginagomoga, nagaila kahau hunato. Kefo AvamuꞋmoꞋa nagai munala aguꞋafi faleno maineno tusi havi kava hu-neꞋa-te.” huno hie.

Higeno YisasiꞋa nagola osi ke kanoꞋa ohunegi agaiꞋaenema tokaeꞋya nemaiya anagaꞋmoꞋya agaife mage me hae “Ani aꞋmoꞋa tagai takave neꞋeno tusiya huno keha keha nehuno tutu nehigi kagaya hu-tegeno vino.” huꞋya hae.
YisasiꞋa mage hie “Isalelima vaꞋyagi-mainea sipi sipileke Anumaya KotiꞋa hu-na-tegeꞋna emainoe.” huno hie.
Higeno ani aꞋmoꞋa Yisasi aiyafi aleꞋya meye-maineno mage huno hie “Ala kanomogae naya huo.” huno hie.
Higeno YisasiꞋa mage huno hie “Havigu nafaꞋneyagamogami kave hama-faleꞋya kalamogami amamisagi nagaya Isaleli veala amataleꞋna alu vayaꞋne amaya hisuana haviya hugahie.” huno hie.

Higeno ani aꞋmoꞋa mage huno hie “Ala kanomogae tamage nehananagi kalamogamina neꞋamafaꞋya nenageꞋya kalamoꞋya sipaletiꞋma asaga hu-lavia atupaꞋa yogiꞋya nenae. Kagaya ani kava huka nagaya Isaleli a omainogi osiꞋa nahaꞋmao.” huno hie.
Higeno YisasiꞋa mage hie “AꞋmogae tusiya huka nagaifena havika kagupi maleka kametiti hanafe nahavigana yana kamigahue.” huno nehigeno ani kana kanoꞋale munaꞋamona kanale hu-tene.
YisasiꞋa kasagoꞋya kali veaꞋne alino kanale hu-ma-tene.
YisasiꞋa ani kumala ataleno Kalili ti kotumo agegayalega uteno nago agoꞋyafi haino mopale maine.

MainegeꞋya kasagoꞋya veala agaite melitalu nehuꞋya aiya avayu hu-mainea veaꞋnene aiya aya haviya hu-mainea veaꞋnene amaulaga asu hu-mainea veaꞋnene age tagaꞋne-mai veaꞋnene nagoꞋa kali veaꞋnene amavaleꞋya Yisasina aiyafi mematageno alino kanale hu-ma-tene.

Kanale hu-ma-tegeꞋya mukiꞋa veala agayana higeꞋya tusiꞋa amamaꞋyo ai-mainae. Age tagaꞋne-mai veaꞋmoꞋya kaiyeke hageꞋya amaiya amayamo kayagi-mai veaꞋmogamina amaiya amayaꞋmoꞋa kanale higeꞋya amaiya haviya hu-mainea veaꞋmogami amaiyamoꞋa kanale higeꞋya neꞋvageꞋya amaulaga asu hu-mainea veaꞋmogami amaulagamoꞋa kanale higeꞋya amaulaga age-mainae. NaꞋama haya yate ageteꞋya Isaleli veaꞋmogami Anumaya Koti agia alisaga hu-mainae.
YisasiꞋa fo tauseniꞋa vaya (4,000) kave amamine.

YisasiꞋa agaiꞋaenema tokaeꞋya nemaiya anagafe ke higeꞋya ageno mage hie “Mani veaꞋmoꞋya taliꞋa (3) yupa nagaiꞋene mainageno nesaya kaveꞋamia omalea yafe nahau hu-neꞋama-toe. Havigu amatalesugeꞋya katega nevisageno amakatesigeꞋya amaugetuꞋnatu huꞋya takatiyafena nonahaiye.” huno hie.
HigeꞋya agaiꞋaenema tokaeꞋya nemaiya anagaꞋmoꞋya mage huꞋya hapaiye “Mani kotega vaya omai kotegagi hanateti kosa hesia maya alita ani veaꞋnea amamisune?” huꞋya havigae.
Hageno YisasiꞋa mage huno hama-vige “Tamakaya naꞋmagi maya hane?” huno higeꞋya mage hae “Tagaya seveniꞋa (7) mayaꞋage hanegi nagola osi noyame kanoꞋa hane.” huꞋya hapaiye.
Hageno YisasiꞋa mukiꞋa veafena “Mopale maiho.” huno hama-paigeꞋya mopale mainae.
Mopale mainageno YisasiꞋa ani seveniꞋa (7) mayaene noyamene alino Anumayamotega muse huno havigeteno kolite kolite huno agaiꞋaenema tokaeꞋya nemaiya anagala amamigeꞋya mukiꞋa veaꞋmogamina amaminae.
AmamigeꞋya mukiꞋa veala nageno amamu higeꞋya atalaya maya atupayaga agaiꞋaenema tokaeꞋya nemaiya anagaꞋmoꞋya alitalu huteꞋya seveniꞋa (7) kupi ai-hava-te-mainae.
Ani kaveꞋma ne-mainaya veneꞋnea fo tauseniꞋa (4,000) vemoꞋya ne-mainae. NafaꞋneyagaꞋamiene aꞋneyagaꞋamiene nayanagi ohapalinae.
Netageno YisasiꞋa hu-mategeꞋya utageno agaiꞋa tipi kalefi haisaga hu-maino Magatana kaiyaga umaine.
